omni_control.scope: Focused run with no declaring test, no omni spawn and no delegation. This is not proof of omni or native execution.

proof_policy: Per-test PASS applies only to the named assertions and fixture boundary. The aggregate run is FAIL. Build success is not browser behavior. No native receipt, C17 physical continuity or absent producer execution is inferred.
